title: Tampere Hall
scope: Standing Tampere Hall concert and congress centre at Yliopistonkatu 55, including the raised entrance colonnade, ceramic-clad auditorium, blue cylindrical core, curved park-side glass lobby and later lower exhibition wings.
limitations: The complex follows its mapped exterior. Roof levels, the separate internal volume lengths, column depth, glazing bays and rooftop service fittings are estimated from the contemporary photographs and operator descriptions.

The Sorsapuisto and street views date to 2013 and 2016. Modern parts visible in the current footprint are included with simplified heights. Temporary displays, banners, flags, and exterior art are outside this model.
The connected Courtyard hotel has its own mapped envelope and is excluded from the hall model.
